microphone_match.description: Preferred microphone name, for example UACDemoV1.0 or USB Audio. The plugin finds this capture device again even if its ALSA card number changes after moving USB ports. Leave blank to automatically prefer a USB capture device.

input_device.description: Advanced ALSA device override such as plughw:1,0. Leave blank/auto to use microphone detection above.

sensitivity.description: Visual microphone gain. 4.0 is the calibrated default.

debug_frequency.description: Frequency sampled by Debug: Sensitivity Calibration. All 16 debug bars sample this same frequency.

keep_active.description: Keep the Audio Visualizer on screen continuously and prevent normal plugin rotation. Disable to make it participate in the normal rotation.

fft_size.description: FFT window size; larger values improve low-frequency resolution but add latency

bar_count.description: Number of spectrum bars. Default is 16 for a 128x32 display.

smoothing.description: Higher values make bar motion smoother; lower values react faster

peak_decay.description: Peak marker decay speed in pixels per frame

show_peaks.description: Show falling peak markers above each bar

color_high.description: RGB colour for high-level bars and peak markers

display_duration.description: Normal rotation display duration in seconds
